text:
Samira (CEO): Quick weekly — two top priorities this sprint: 1) Private GA readiness (finalize data retention policy + KMS onboarding) and 2) v0.9 routing rollout. Heads-up: we keep launch gated on Security + SRE signoff. Please confirm by EOD Thursday.

Priya (VP Product): We're ready on docs, customer comms, and training. One outstanding item: KMS smoke test. @Jordan can you validate the runbook and KMS flows?

Jordan (SRE): Will run the smoke + chaos run tonight and update the runbook. Quick perf snapshot from today's evening canary:
```
p50: 40ms
p95: 118ms
error-rate: 0.4%
gpu-util: 72%
```
Goal to hit for GA: p95 <= 95ms and error-rate < 0.7%. If canary moves above those thresholds we rollback.

OpsBot: Deploy event: rwd-routing v0.9 canary started (5%) by Priya at 1968008800. Logs: https://deploys.internal/rwd-routing/1968008800 :gear:

Evan (VP Eng): Engineering will hold canary at 5% for 24h, instrumented with the new tracing hooks. Rollback rule: error-rate > 1.5% OR p95 > 150ms triggers auto-rollback. I'll also add a dashboard tile for the exec view.

Priya (VP Product): Checklist: customer comms ✅, docs ✅, CSM briefing ✅, KMS smoke test pending. Samira, Security signoff required for GA flag.

Samira (CEO): Thanks — two asks: (1) @Evan, make sure rollback plan is rehearsed and the runbook link is in the exec dashboard; (2) @Jordan, please post the chaos run results in #incidents and ping me if anything looks risky. If Security signs off by Fri morning, we proceed with phased GA next week. Appreciated — keep updates short in-thread. :rocket:
